description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics within a dataset, labeled “Daily Life”. The chart contains ten slices representing different categories. The largest slice, labeled “Business”, is light blue and occupies approximately 24.3% of the chart. “Econ. & Fin.” is colored orange and represents 18.4% of the total. “Game&Anime” is colored red and accounts for 8.2%, matching the proportion of the slice labeled “History”, which is yellow. “Law” is a slightly darker blue and represents 5.1%, while “Science” is a lighter blue and is 6.7%. “Geography” is green and represents 2.7%, and “Math” is a darker green and is 1.2%. “Med & Health” is colored yellow and represents 6.7%, and finally, “Pet & Animal” is colored red and represents 5.9%. A legend is provided alongside the chart, listing each category and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
